uses.rationale: Graphics-led scene with a message_thread visual block and no footage; scene-composition draws it with the spring bubbles and slow push-in from the spec.
Punchy hook into the demo; a hard cut keeps pace tight and matches the cut transition_out.
The ui_demo visual block is drawn entirely by scene-composition, which shows the cursor selecting a bakery and the confirm button.
Storyboard asks for a wipe out of the UI demo. Energetic and graphic, suits a UI reveal. 0.5s is within half of the 4s scene. Uses 1 of 3.
The process_flow block is drawn by scene-composition: three connected steps with the rightward pan.
Soft blend from the explanatory flow into the calm end card; 0.6s is the default and within half the scene.

The end_card visual block is drawn by scene-composition with the wordmark and single Get Crumb button. No end-card-cta or text recipe is added, and no transition is needed because this is the final scene.
